steps.name: Morning in Rashuet
steps.objective: Report the quest to [Narsha] at the “Slum Rashuet Entrance”.

steps.name: Kaina's message
steps.objective:
1. Talk to [Narsha] at the 「Slum Rashuet Entrance」, and go to the portal near [Sylvia] at 「Glaston Central Square」.
2. After the conversation, go to the “street north of the square” and report the quest to [Leticia].

lines.text: (Small birds, which were busy flying, land on the clothesline hanging between the houses. And then they chirp as if announcing the beginning of morning.)
(Narsha, who came out to the front of the inn, looked at the birds and yawned softly.)

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: Haam… .

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: My whole body feels sore from just resting and doing nothing. Hmm.
(Narsha, who was stretching, senses someone's presence and turns around.)

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: %s. hello.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Narsha, did you sleep well?

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: I barely fell asleep.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Why?

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: I am truly grateful for your Majesty's convenience. However, I was wondering if I could enjoy all of this.

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: They changed all the beds at the Rashuet Inn to luxurious ones, and provided snacks that you would only eat in an imperial castle... .

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: There are a lot of drivers stationed on Lashuette Street, including near the inn... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Narsha looks a little tired...)

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: %s, I want to go home.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Narsha, I know you want to go home, but please be patient. Your Majesty told you to wait a moment.

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: I guess it's because it's my first time staying in Glaston for this long.

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: Hey… , Did Raven do something bad?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Well… .

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: Seeing that the knights are chasing me, I thought it wouldn't be normal.

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: Hmm… . uh?
(A large shadow, as if swallowing the sun, falls over Narsha's head.)

lines.speaker: 아르젠트
lines.text: Are you two resting well?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Welcome, Argent. We rested well thanks to His Majesty's great consideration.

lines.speaker: 아르젠트
lines.text: Thank goodness.
(Argent makes eye contact with Narsha, who is looking at him.)

lines.speaker: 아르젠트
lines.text: Miss Narsha, a paladin named Platinum will come to visit you tomorrow under orders from His Majesty.

lines.speaker: 아르젠트
lines.text: I've entrusted him with your escort, so you can return together. Oh, he will also bring the card, so please ask for it.

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: Ah, card… . Thank you, Argent.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: That's great, Narsha.

lines.speaker: 아르젠트
lines.text: I will explain everything about the Magic Agency wizard Raven when the time comes.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Will it take a long time to chase that wizard?)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes?

lines.speaker: 아르젠트
lines.text: There is a place for you to go together.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ah… , yes. I'll prepare it soon.

lines.speaker: 아르젠트
lines.text: I'll wait here.
(While Adventurer went into the inn and packed up her luggage, Narsha and Argent, who were standing quietly outside, made eye contact.)

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: I… Mr. Argent.

lines.speaker: 아르젠트
lines.text: Miss Narsha?

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: Is the place you are going with Adventurer dangerous?

lines.speaker: 아르젠트
lines.text: No. I'm just going along to deliver Your Majesty's message. You said everything would be okay, so you don't have to worry too much.

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: Thank goodness. I thought it was a dangerous place again... .
(Narsha finds Adventurer that just came out and is silent.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I've packed my bags, Argent. And Narsha… .

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: Yes, Adventurer.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: If I go now, I don't know when I'll be back, so I'll say hello in advance.

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: It's okay, %s. It was a pleasure coming to Glaston together. See you later then. Argent, please be careful too.

lines.speaker: 아르젠트
lines.text: Miss Narsha, goodbye then… .
(Narsha greets Argent and %s and enters the inn again.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Argent, where should I go?

lines.speaker: 아르젠트
lines.text: Please follow me.
(Follow Argent and arrive at the road next to the cafe in the square. As you walk, residents greet Argent or give him longing looks.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (I can feel that Argent is trusted by the residents. Huh?)
(Argent, who was leading, stops and looks back.)

lines.speaker: 아르젠트
lines.text: This way. This road will take you to the administrative district.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: If it's an administrative district... .

lines.speaker: 아르젠트
lines.text: This is an area where government offices that carry out national affairs are located. There is no end to what I can tell you about the imperial offices, but if there is one that %s would know about... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It's the Magic Agency.

lines.speaker: 아르젠트
lines.text: Yes. I'll take my time talking about the Magic Agency, but I have a friend I'd like to introduce to you.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Sylvia? If you're Sylvia, we've met before.

lines.speaker: 아르젠트
lines.text: Not Sylvia. I'm sorry, but why did you think it was Sylvia... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Sylvia is coming from over there.
(Silvia is coming to the square from the north street and stops when she spots Argent.)

lines.speaker: 실비아
lines.text: … Ha, I watched Argent during my sweet break... .
(Argent's expression hardens when he spots Sylvia.)

lines.speaker: 아르젠트
lines.text: I thought it was time for you to work now.

lines.speaker: 실비아
lines.text: Do you think I'm just resting and not working? Then brother, why are you here? I'm sure he didn't show up to nag you.

lines.speaker: 아르젠트
lines.text: %s, I have some business for you, so I'm going to the administrative district with you... . I won't explain it at length. Okay?

lines.speaker: 실비아
lines.text: Yeah? Then don't worry about me and just pass by.

lines.speaker: 아르젠트
lines.text: I know there is a rest room at the Record Center, but why come to the square to rest? .

lines.speaker: 실비아
lines.text: It's a bit awkward for me to be the youngest person in an office where there are only elderly people, and to sit in the only lounge.

lines.speaker: 실비아
lines.text: Now, the elderly people say it's okay to go outside for a while, so they're here.
(Argent nods in understanding.)

lines.speaker: 아르젠트
lines.text: I know what you mean. Take a break and go back in. And this… .
(Argent holds Silvia’s hand and gives her several gold coins taken from his arms.)

lines.speaker: 아르젠트
lines.text: I can't stand being bored. Buy some snacks and go in. Take care of the elderly too.

lines.speaker: 실비아
lines.text: I will obey your orders, Captain.

lines.speaker: 아르젠트
lines.text: Don't just listen to me in times like this.
(Silvia puts the gold coin in her pocket and grins.)

lines.speaker: 실비아
lines.text: See you later, %s. Brother, you work hard too.
(Silvia hurries toward the cafe with a flushed expression.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: The siblings seem to get along well.

lines.speaker: 아르젠트
lines.text: Well, I don't know. I'm not sure... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ahaha… . yes.

lines.speaker: 아르젠트
lines.text: Now, come this way.

steps.name: unusual girl
steps.objective: Talk to [Leticia] in the “North Street of the Square” and report the quest to [Iris] in the “Oracle’s Room.”

lines.text: (As %s was walking up the street on the north side of the square along Argent, another area came into view in the distance.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: That's the administrative district.

lines.speaker: 아르젠트
lines.text: Yes.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: You said it was North Street, right? It's somehow quiet here.

lines.speaker: 아르젠트
lines.text: It's a little after work time.

lines.speaker: 아르젠트
lines.text: Let me get to the point here. There was a message from His Majesty.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes?

lines.speaker: 아르젠트
lines.text: Your Majesty says he will soon put pressure on the nobles in Parliament. And he asked me a favor.

lines.speaker: 아르젠트
lines.text: As the matter was resolved a while ago, the magic shaking Glaston stopped for a moment, and Raven disappeared in the meantime.

lines.speaker: 아르젠트
lines.text: Maybe it has something to do with it... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: A wizard named Raven... , what is it?

lines.speaker: 아르젠트
lines.text: It's not accurate, but... , Raven was at the center of all the bad things the Ministry was doing.

lines.speaker: 아르젠트
lines.text: I tried to awaken the Demon God through Noname and Atalanta, and I tried to use Narsha in other ways.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Could it be that the request His Majesty spoke of was... .

lines.speaker: 아르젠트
lines.text: What you thought was correct. Finding evidence of what Raven did... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It's been a while, but hasn't all the evidence been destroyed?

lines.speaker: 아르젠트
lines.text: His Majesty says there must be something Raven couldn't touch. So I need some information about that stuff.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: If Raven can't touch it... .

lines.speaker: 아르젠트
lines.text: It may be something that ordinary humans cannot find or touch.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Hmm… , I know what you mean.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Please give me some time.

lines.speaker: 아르젠트
lines.text: Okay. I will convey that to Your Majesty.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh, that's right. Where is the person you would like to introduce?
(Argent points to a girl looking at the surrounding scenery from afar.)
(The girl who was looking in the direction of the administrative district feels the presence of someone and turns around.)
Uh, Captain?

lines.speaker: 아르젠트
lines.text: The greeting is omitted.
Yes. So far, nothing major has happened in the administrative district. Since you told me to report even the smallest details, I will tell you.
The magic hall is no longer shaking.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Excited...?)
The wizards say that the Magic Agency has a lot of magic tools, so their magical powers clash with each other. They say that the building often shakes in the aftermath.

lines.speaker: 아르젠트
lines.text: When did that stop?
I think it was around that time when His Majesty visited Rashuet not long ago.

lines.speaker: 아르젠트
lines.text: Hmm… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: No way… .
… Why are you like that?

lines.speaker: 아르젠트
lines.text: No… .
(The girl who reported the situation in the administrative district to Argent smiles brightly and waves.)

lines.speaker: 레티시아
lines.text: Hello. I am knight Leticia. You can call me Leti.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It was an article. I didn't know.

lines.speaker: 레티시아
lines.text: That article is right, hehe. It's not an official article, it's just a free article.

lines.speaker: 레티시아
lines.text: I was originally an apprentice knight, but I was fooled by the rumor that I could become a Terrorite and helped with research at the Ministry of Magic. However, problems arose and I had to quit.

lines.speaker: 레티시아
lines.text: You thought I wasn't a knight because of my clothes. The leader said that anything is okay as long as he maintains his duties.

lines.speaker: 아르젠트
lines.text: I'm sorry... . I should have stopped it... .

lines.speaker: 레티시아
lines.text: What are you sorry about, leader? I'm fine. It's not like I'm sick or anything.

lines.speaker: 레티시아
lines.text: It was actually nice to have telekinetic powers. He's cool like a terrorist knight.

lines.speaker: 아르젠트
lines.text: Terror Knight is not like that... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Magic Agency research? Telekinesis?

lines.speaker: 레티시아
lines.text: Yes. Telekinesis. If you concentrate, you can levitate small objects. Look at my hands for a moment.
(Leticia points to a small stone on the floor with her fingertip. After a while, the stone rises and moves at the motion of Leticia's hand.)

lines.speaker: 레티시아
lines.text: I guess you were very surprised to see that you were at a loss for words? I was surprised that I was able to write at some point too. Hehehe.

lines.speaker: 아르젠트
lines.text: Leti, I told you not to show that carelessly... .

lines.speaker: 레티시아
lines.text: … Everyone in Glaston knows this. Sylvia also said it was cool.

lines.speaker: 아르젠트
lines.text: His Majesty told me to just leave it alone, but... .

lines.speaker: 레티시아
lines.text: I have this ability, but I want to use it well and put it to good use. Just like the leader.

lines.speaker: 아르젠트
lines.text: … Letty, stop.
(Only when Leticia sees Argent's frowning expression does she step back.)

lines.speaker: 레티시아
lines.text: Yes, I'm sorry.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'd like to hear more about what the Magic Agency's research was about... .

lines.speaker: 아르젠트
lines.text: If you ask Letty more questions, you won't get a straight answer. All memories of the research process were lost.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Then there is nothing we can do.

lines.speaker: 레티시아
lines.text: By the way, Captain, what brought you here?

lines.speaker: 아르젠트
lines.text: I’m here to introduce Letty to %s. I think Letty will have to help %s in the future.

lines.speaker: 레티시아
lines.text: Oh, is this an escort mission? I've wanted to try this for a while.

lines.speaker: 아르젠트
lines.text: A kind of escort… I don't know if it's comfortable to think like that.

lines.speaker: 레티시아
lines.text: Okay, Captain. I will work hard to protect %s.

lines.speaker: 레티시아
lines.text: %s, please introduce yourself.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: The introduction is late. I am… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Introduce yourself briefly to Leticia.)

lines.speaker: 레티시아
lines.text: Wow, you are a great person. I don't know.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: No. are you okay. Then, take care of yourself, Letty.

lines.speaker: 레티시아
lines.text: Please take care of me.
(Leticia holds %s's hand and shakes it.)

lines.speaker: 레티시아
lines.text: I have a favor to ask you. If you are this great, do you have a card certified by the imperial family? Could you please show me?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: This?

lines.speaker: 레티시아
lines.text: Wow, it's true. This is really my first time seeing it. With this, even passing soldiers will be unable to move.

lines.speaker: 아르젠트
lines.text: %s As you know, the holder of that card is recognized by the Imperial Family and receives corresponding benefits.

lines.speaker: 아르젠트
lines.text: We've paid a lot of attention recently, so regular soldiers won't treat us carelessly.

lines.speaker: 레티시아
lines.text: Is it really good?

lines.speaker: 아르젠트
lines.text: Letty. Now it's time to patrol, right?

lines.speaker: 레티시아
lines.text: Oh, that's right. The time has already come to this. Now, I'm going to go look around the administrative district.

lines.speaker: 레티시아
lines.text: See you later, %s and the leader.
(Leticia greets Argent and %s and runs straight toward the administrative district.)

lines.speaker: 아르젠트
lines.text: Even though he looks like that, he is a very talented article.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I believe it when Argent says that.

lines.speaker: 아르젠트
lines.text: If you come back to Glaston, look for Leticia right away. When it comes to administrative districts, Leticia knows everything.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I see. I'm going to visit the sanctuary for a moment.

lines.speaker: 아르젠트
lines.text: Ah, you asked for time... . All right. See you later.

steps.name: A frustrated heart
steps.objective: Talk to [Iris] in the “Oracle’s Room” and report the quest to [Leticia] in the “North Street of the Square”.

lines.text: (The space that always welcomed Adventurer with white light and flowers feels a little lonely.)
(In the middle of that space, Iris stands with his eyes closed.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Iris?

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: Huh? %s… . When did you come?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Iris, what's wrong?

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: I was a bit surprised because I didn't feel popular. Oh, I have something to say to %s.

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: Not long ago, I felt scared and scared, but I saw hope beyond the great wall. Just a little more and you'll be fine.

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: It's all thanks to %s.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: That's because Iris is doing well.

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: I need to exert a little more strength.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Iris, how about taking a short break? I think I'm exhausted from doing so much.

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: As you know, I can't rest. If something happens that you can't do anything about during a short break... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: If you're anxious because of Hecate's visit... .

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: That's not it. Hecate must also feel my will.
(Iris hesitates for a moment.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Iris?

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: After Hecate left, my grandmother’s memories came back to me.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Grandmother?

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: I think I had forgotten my grandmother who passed away at some point.

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: I couldn't believe I had forgotten my grandmother, who was a family member like no other in the world and a very precious person... . It obviously doesn't make sense... .

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: It was as if part of my memory had been erased, and I couldn't remember my grandmother... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Really?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Do you remember everything now?

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: I remember almost everything. However, I don't know how my grandmother died... . That's not the only thing that comes to mind.

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: As if someone was preventing me from recalling my memories... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Hmm… .

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: Phew… . uh?
(Iris makes an expression as if he has realized something. Then he stretches gently.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Iris?

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: That stuffiness is gone.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Really?

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: I guess I should have told you about it sooner. It was frustrating because I kept it in my mind for no reason. I promised I wouldn't hide it... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: … It's a different case this time. are you okay.

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: I'm sorry.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Is this really okay?

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: Yes… . Oh, that's right. Are you here to talk about what His Majesty has asked you to do?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes, that's right. Uh, so now we're hearing Glaston's story?

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: With the help of the spirits, I was able to understand a certain amount of things, except for a few.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: If some… You mean the magic office, right?

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: That's right. If there is anything I can help with, please let me know right away.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Really?
(Iris nods quietly.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Thank you, Iris. I don't think it will happen anytime soon, but if it does, I'll ask Iris.

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: Yes… . How are you feeling now?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I had a good rest, but I'm not sure.

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: Then, do you want to stay a little longer? You will recover quickly.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Is that okay?

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: Of course.
(Adventurer takes a short break in the oracle's room and returns to Glaston with the help of Iris.)

steps.name: noisy street
steps.objective: Talk to [Leticia] in the “Street North of the Square” and defeat the [Newbie Owl Mage] in the “Glaston Administrative District”. Then, report the quest to [Leticia] in the Glaston Administrative District.

lines.speaker: 사람들의 목소리
lines.text: Everyone, go to the square!! Evacuate quickly!! Cluck, cluck.

lines.speaker: 사람들의 목소리
lines.text: Seniors and children, please quickly go over there, to the square!!
(Many people's voices can be heard on a street where the dust is thick and you cannot see ahead.)
(The street on the north side of the square appears little by little through the dust.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Huh? Have I arrived? But why is there so much dust?

lines.speaker: 사람들의 목소리
lines.text: Don't stay idly here and escape quickly!! Go to the square!! Cluck, cluck.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: … What happened?
(As we move forward to investigate the situation, a large cloud of dust rises and spreads like a whirlpool again. Then, a shadow that does not appear to belong to a person appears.)
(The being that was running towards the people as if it was going to attack them soon falls down with a loud sound at the feet of Adventurer.)
Boom.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: … What is this?
(What fell on the floor was a kind of golem-like monster created by combining magic books.)
After… , I’m glad I stopped it.
(Someone sees the fallen monster and sighs in relief.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Letty?

lines.speaker: 레티시아
lines.text: %s? Ah, this is a big deal!!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Calm down.

lines.speaker: 레티시아
lines.text: While on patrol, monsters suddenly appeared in the magic office! So, I quickly reported to the leader and called the drivers to evacuate the people!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Monster? In the magic hall?

lines.speaker: 레티시아
lines.text: Yes!! At the magic office!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Is Letty okay?

lines.speaker: 레티시아
lines.text: I'm fine! We have to stop the monsters quickly!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Do you really look okay? The people who were evacuating kept coughing...)
(As I was looking around, knights armed with large gauntlets appeared and filled the street.)

lines.speaker: 아르젠트
lines.text: Letty, have you evacuated everyone over there? Cluck, cluck.

lines.speaker: 레티시아
lines.text: Yes, Captain!

lines.speaker: 아르젠트
lines.text: The technicians have all checked this, but just in case, go in and check further… . Uh, %s? Were you here?

lines.speaker: 아르젠트
lines.text: I'm glad you're safe. First, let me tell you the current situation.

lines.speaker: 아르젠트
lines.text: A kind of miasma is spreading in the form of dust from the magic office. And monsters drawn by that miasma appeared on the streets.

lines.speaker: 아르젠트
lines.text: The miasma is not very dangerous, but these monsters can go to the square or the castle, so the knights go into the administrative district to stop them.

lines.speaker: 아르젠트
lines.text: Maybe now... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes, I think it's time to do that.

lines.speaker: 아르젠트
lines.text: Okay.
(Argent nods his head as if he understands. Then he moves his gaze to Leti.)

lines.speaker: 레티시아
lines.text: Captain, what do you mean?

lines.speaker: 아르젠트
lines.text: Leti, this is a special mission.

lines.speaker: 레티시아
lines.text: Is this a special mission?

lines.speaker: 아르젠트
lines.text: Hurry up and take %s to the magic office. If you find someone who was unable to evacuate, please inform them of a safe place.

lines.speaker: 레티시아
lines.text: I understand. No, I understand, Captain.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'll go right away.

lines.speaker: 아르젠트
lines.text: See you later, %s.
(As soon as Argent puts on the helmet he was holding, he runs somewhere. Then, other waiting knights follow Argent.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Looking at that many knights being deployed, it looks like there are a lot of monsters.

lines.speaker: 레티시아
lines.text: Yes, there are so many! There are already dozens of monsters I've caught.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (I said he was a very skilled driver, but is that really true?)

lines.speaker: 레티시아
lines.text: %s, are you coming? If we keep going like this, we won't be able to go near the magic building! I'll guide you, so go quickly!
(From the moment they step into the administrative district, monsters appear and interfere with the two people.)
(They are only outnumbered, and the monster is not that strong, so it falls helplessly in front of the two people.)

lines.speaker: 레티시아
lines.text: Wow, %s. It's amazing. Ta-da, you can kill all these monsters at once.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Letty fought well too.

lines.speaker: 레티시아
lines.text: Hehe. Thank you for the compliment. If you follow this road all the way, you will reach the Magic Office.

lines.speaker: 레티시아
lines.text: Uh, %s, there's someone over there. He looks like a magician from the Magic Agency, but looking at him looking exhausted, I guess he's been working for a few days without being able to go home.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Wizard?
(Where Leticia pointed, a wizard she had seen once was going somewhere. He had messy hair, wore large glasses, and was holding a magic book in his arms...)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Wait, is that… Raven?)

lines.speaker: 레티시아
lines.text: There, there wizard!
(Raven, hearing Leticia's voice, turns around. Then, upon discovering that Adventurer is there, he runs forward as if running away.)

lines.speaker: 레티시아
lines.text: Wizard! Wizard man! Where are you going?! Come back!!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ah, Letty… .

lines.speaker: 레티시아
lines.text: Yes?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: How much should I explain? It's a bit complicated... .

lines.speaker: 레티시아
lines.text: I'm not sure, but I'm sure magicians are involved in this?

lines.speaker: 레티시아
lines.text: This is happening around the Magic Office, but none of the Magic Office wizards have shown up. What on earth are you doing if you're not even evacuating?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Leti, where is the magic office?

lines.speaker: 레티시아
lines.text: The Magic Office is located at the highest point visible when entering the administrative district. Can't you see it from here? Oh, the dust is gone.

lines.speaker: 레티시아
lines.text: I know the quick way. Please follow me.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Please, Letty.

steps.name: A building that explodes with magic
steps.objective: Talk to [Leticia] in the 「Glaston Administrative District」, and defeat [Suspended Optica] and [Elemental Book Golem] in the 「Glaston Administrative District」. Then, report the quest to [Leticia] in the Glaston Administrative District.

lines.speaker: 레티시아
lines.text: %s, we're here. This is the magic office.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Here… .
(The white building, which is smaller than other government offices, is full of an ominous feeling. Moreover, it is shaking slightly as you don't know what is happening inside.)

lines.speaker: 레티시아
lines.text: It's definitely strange... .
(The moment Leticia approaches the magic office building, a loud bird cry is heard from somewhere.)
Pour!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Owl?)
(An owl wearing a wizard's hat flies over and falls in front of Leticia.)

lines.speaker: 레티시아
lines.text: Peekaboo? Peekaboo! Come to your senses!
(Leticia grabs the fallen owl with both hands and raises it up. The owl recognizes Leticia and starts crying.)

lines.speaker: 피카부
lines.text: Pour! Woooooooo!

lines.speaker: 레티시아
lines.text: Peekaboo, today is your day off. What on earth happened?

lines.speaker: 피카부
lines.text: Pour up!! hoot!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Letty, what does this owl say?

lines.speaker: 레티시아
lines.text: I don't know. There's no way a person can understand what an owl is saying.

lines.speaker: 레티시아
lines.text: Peekaboo, we're going into the magic building.

lines.speaker: 피카부
lines.text: Pour!! Pour!
(The owl hears Leticia's words and is startled and flies forward to block her.)

lines.speaker: 레티시아
lines.text: %s, it seems like Peekaboo is telling us not to go in. It's clear something is happening... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Letty, this owl understands human speech to some extent, right?

lines.speaker: 레티시아
lines.text: Yes, Peekaboo is an owl that has been raised by magicians from the Ministry of Magic since ancient times because it is smart and can handle magic.

lines.speaker: 레티시아
lines.text: He's good at using magic and running errands, so he's popular with people. Kids like it too.

lines.speaker: 피카부
lines.text: Ow!
(Peek-a-boo flaps its wings as if it is correct. Then points to the magic building and puts its wings together to make an X.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Can’t I just go in like this? Oh, is there anyone who understands what owls say?
Sting.
(At that time, along with the chirping of a bird that I heard somewhere, a large, dark shadow falls over the magic building.)

lines.speaker: 레티시아
lines.text: Ugh, what is that? Get off, get off!
(Something big and blue in the air falls towards the two people, but a different sound is heard than expected.)
Wow.

lines.speaker: 레티시아
lines.text: Wow, the fat bird got smaller and fell on %s's head.
Sting. Sting.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Sir Sylphid? How did you get here?

lines.speaker: 실피드
lines.text: Sting. I came by flying. Hey kid, I'm not fat.

lines.speaker: 레티시아
lines.text: Wow, it's a talking bird.

lines.speaker: 실피드
lines.text: Sting. Peekaboo says that magic power is running wild inside that building. What's in the warehouse?

lines.speaker: 피카부
lines.text: Pour!

lines.speaker: 실피드
lines.text: Damn, the seal on the banned book has been broken, but even Peekaboo doesn't know how it was released. He asks me to save his friends inside... .

lines.speaker: 실피드
lines.text: Sting. Ugh. In this condition, no one can enter. The magical power that emerges from banned books does not belong to our world.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes?

lines.speaker: 실피드
lines.text: Sting. %s, it's a long explanation. First, I'll use some strength, so take out the bad guys nearby.

lines.speaker: 실피드
lines.text: Sting. In the meantime, Peekaboo and I will dissipate some of the magic here.

lines.speaker: 피카부
lines.text: Ow?

lines.speaker: 실피드
lines.text: Sting. Peekaboo, listen carefully. Right now, I don't have enough wings or a beak, so I can't play around. yes?

lines.speaker: 실피드
lines.text: Sting. This is not the time to nag. %s, hurry.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Then, Silphid, please ask me a favor. Letty, did you hear?

lines.speaker: 레티시아
lines.text: What is this bluebird talking about?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'll talk about the details later. First of all, as Silphid told us, we will prevent monsters from coming near us.

lines.speaker: 레티시아
lines.text: Yes. I won't let you come properly!

steps.name: Forbidden book that has been unsealed
steps.objective: Talk to [Leticia] in the “Glaston Administrative District” and defeat [Ego Notorai] in the “Eroded Magic Building.” Then, report the quest to [Leticia] in the Glaston Administrative District.

lines.speaker: 피카부
lines.text: Pour!

lines.speaker: 실피드
lines.text: Sting. Yes, that's how you do it. Come on, let's do it!
(Sylphid flies above the magic building with Peekaboo. Then, it spreads out its short wings and flaps them vigorously.)
(The moment a wind carrying strong magical power blows and approaches the magic building, the shaking movement of the magic building stops.)

lines.speaker: 실피드
lines.text: Sting. This should be fine. Peekaboo. Go get the kids. for a moment… . Just stop for a second. Do you know who that is?

lines.speaker: 피카부
lines.text: Swollen? ok?

lines.speaker: 실피드
lines.text: Sting. Wizard Raven?
(The wizard approaching the magic building raises his head and looks at the sky.)

lines.speaker: 레이븐
lines.text: I thought your skill in dispersing the flow of magical power was amazing, and the Spirit King has come.

lines.speaker: 실피드
lines.text: Sting. Who are you?
(Raven shows a faint smile when she sees the sylphid flying in front of her.)

lines.speaker: 레이븐
lines.text: I wish we had met a little earlier. It's a shame.

lines.speaker: 레이븐
lines.text: It would have been one of the great ingredients to create Demiurge... .
(Sylphid, who knew what those words meant, furrowed her brows and stretched out her small wings.)
(Then, a whirlwind-shaped cloud begins to gather from somewhere.)

lines.speaker: 레이븐
lines.text: I have important work to do, so I don't have time to deal with spirits... .
(A shadow appears on Raven's face. After a moment, the spellbook opens in half and several black arms extend from within.)
(Sylphid flies around to avoid the black arms, but before he knows it, his ankles are grabbed.)

lines.speaker: 레이븐
lines.text: I won't destroy it, so just be patient. I don't have time to research right now... .
(Raven laughs lightly and hurries into the magic building. After a while, the black arm gradually turns into a large curtain of darkness, trying to engulf Sylphid.)

lines.speaker: 실피드
lines.text: Sting!! Well, what is it? This is... . Ugh, ugh.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Silphid!!
(Adventurer hurriedly tears the black curtain and takes out Sylphid from within.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Are you okay?

lines.speaker: 실피드
lines.text: Sting. It’s okay… . uh?
(Sylphid steps on %s's head and looks at the magic building.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: … I'm shaking harder than before... .

lines.speaker: 실피드
lines.text: Sting. As the wizard who mentioned the demon god goes inside, the magic power inside is shaking more loudly.

lines.speaker: 레티시아
lines.text: Are you saying that magical power reacts to that wizard?

lines.speaker: 실피드
lines.text: Sting. Little boy. You're smart.

lines.speaker: 레티시아
lines.text: Thank you, Blue Bird.

lines.speaker: 실피드
lines.text: Sting. %s.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes, Sylphide.

lines.speaker: 실피드
lines.text: Sting. You were originally going to go into the Magic Agency, right? And you were trying to find that wizard too?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: That's right.

lines.speaker: 실피드
lines.text: Sting. Then hurry up and go inside. I will call the spirits and prevent the magic inside from coming out.

lines.speaker: 실피드
lines.text: Sting. And kid. %s Please take care of me.

lines.speaker: 레티시아
lines.text: Wow, blue bird. Was it a spirit?

lines.speaker: 실피드
lines.text: Sting. It is the spirit king.

lines.speaker: 레티시아
lines.text: It's small now, but it used to be really big. Was it big because he was the king?

lines.speaker: 실피드
lines.text: Sting. That's right. He is big because he is a king! Oh, this isn't important. Go quickly!!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Silphid, then I would like to ask you a favor. Is Letty going to be okay? It could be dangerous.

lines.speaker: 레티시아
lines.text: I am a knight who protects the residents and carries out my duties! You can't pretend not to know what's happening right in front of you!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Phew, I get it. Follow me carefully.
(Adventurer and Leticia take steps to enter the magic building shaking with magic.)

lines.speaker: 실피드
lines.text: Sting. What a unique human kid... . Come on, Peekaboo.

lines.speaker: 피카부
lines.text: Ow?

lines.speaker: 실피드
lines.text: Sting. I need to save my friends. Now, let’s try again what we did before!
(The appearance of the magic office when the two people carefully enter is full of a foreign feeling, completely different from a regular government office.)

lines.speaker: 레티시아
lines.text: %s… . What is this... .
(Leticia rubs her eyes again, as if she does not believe what she is seeing.)
(The space that appears to be the lobby is distorted and distorted. Spellbooks and magic tools are floating above it.)
(And the black curtain-like shadow that tried to engulf Silphid is fluttering like a flame on the floor.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (It feels like time and space are distorted... And what I feel here is...)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (…it’s not normal power….)

lines.speaker: 레티시아
lines.text: %s, look over there.
(The seemingly ordinary stairs leading upstairs are twisted and unfolding endlessly. Raven can be seen in the distance, wondering where to go.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Where is Raven going... ?

lines.speaker: 레티시아
lines.text: The wall with the bookshelf and grandfather clock is in the middle left of the 3rd and 4th floors.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Huh? Letty, how do you know that? Right now, everything in this space is distorted due to magical power... .

lines.speaker: 레티시아
lines.text: I told you before that I was fooled. I remember being inside the magic building before.

lines.speaker: 레티시아
lines.text: I roughly know what's in the lobby and hallways. If you think of it as untangling a mess of rope, you'll come out like, voila!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Really?

lines.speaker: 레티시아
lines.text: Yes, yes. But how far do we go?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I need to see what Raven needs.

lines.speaker: 레티시아
lines.text: If I know what that is, I think I can take care of it... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I don't know exactly what it is. So, I have to search all the way here first. uh?
(As the inside of the twisted magic building shakes, a strange sound that seems to have been made artificially is heard from somewhere.)
Uuuuuuuuuuuuu-.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Where is this sound coming from?
Uuuuuuuuuuuuu-.

lines.speaker: 레티시아
lines.text: %s, I know where that sound is coming from.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Do you know where it is?

lines.speaker: 레티시아
lines.text: Yes, over there. Please follow me.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Letty, stop.

lines.speaker: 레티시아
lines.text: Ah, yes… .
(At that moment, something comes out of the darkness targeting the party. However, it is knocked down by an attack from %s, which it had noticed in advance.)
Boom.

lines.speaker: 레티시아
lines.text: Wow, I almost got into big trouble.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Letty, are you okay? But this… .
(Leticia looks at the fallen being and is speechless.)

lines.speaker: 레티시아
lines.text: This person was a wizard who asked for help with research. Why did it turn into a monster and attack me... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Letty, I don't have time for this. Hey, look in the direction we were going.
(Beings that were humans until recently have turned into monsters and are staring at %s and the group. Leticia hesitates as it looks like they might attack at any moment.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Letty… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I can't explain it in detail, but all the wizards who remained in the magic building would have changed like that.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Once we're in here, we can't get out again. If things continue like this, Glaston could become more dangerous than it is now.

lines.speaker: 레티시아
lines.text: I know what you mean. I'll come to my senses.
(Leticia smiles lightly and makes eye contact with Adventurer. And without saying who will go first, she runs towards the attacking beings.)

lines.speaker: 레티시아
lines.text: Ha, ha... .
(Leticia must have lost strength in her legs as she stands up, holding on to the handrail of the twisted stairs.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Letty, are you okay?

lines.speaker: 레티시아
lines.text: Okay, it's okay. It's my first time facing so many enemies... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Do you want to rest for a bit?
(Letty drinks the potion she received from %s and stretches lightly.)

lines.speaker: 레티시아
lines.text: We're all here, why should we rest?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: You're all there?

lines.speaker: 레티시아
lines.text: I think it's here. I feel like there's something behind there.
Uuuuuuuuuuuuu-.
(%s When the party moves forward, they hear what sounds like a monster's cry.)
Uuuuuuuuuuuuu-.
(The growling sound, as if waiting for the group, grows slightly louder. However, there appears to be no trace of the monster in the tightly closed space.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Why is there only sound and nothing... ?

lines.speaker: 레티시아
lines.text: … Look over there, %s.
(An unknown thing flies out from behind where Leticia pointed.)

lines.speaker: 레티시아
lines.text: Magic book… ?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Letty, step back!
Uuuuuuuuuuuuu-.
(A large ghost-like entity making strange noises appears behind the floating magic book.)
(A strange form of being, unknown whether it is a spirit or a devil, is staring at the two people.)

lines.speaker: 레티시아
lines.text: %s, um, what is that?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'm not sure, but I think the magic office ended up like this because of that monster.
(When the two are on guard, looking for an opportunity to deal with the monster, Raven appears from afar.)

lines.speaker: 레이븐
lines.text: Of all the banned books, Nottoria is the only one that has been unsealed. I have no choice but to solve the rest myself.
(A monster named Nottoria looks at Raven and screams.)
Oooooh!

lines.speaker: 레이븐
lines.text: Nottoria. I'll do whatever you want, just wait a moment.
(As Raven said, Nottoria's movements slow down. A satisfied Raven passes by Nottoria and goes back.)

lines.speaker: 레이븐
lines.text: Where are the rest of the banned books... . It should be like this... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Raven, stop. what are you doing?

lines.speaker: 레이븐
lines.text: I'll leave as soon as I find what I need. I don't want to deal with you. I don't have time to deal with it.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Did you build the magic office like this to find banned books?

lines.speaker: 레이븐
lines.text: You know about banned books. Are you guys looking for banned books too? why? Even if you find it, it's not something you can use.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Answer me.
(Raven continues to look around, ignoring %s's question.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Raven! I don't know what you're trying to do, but stop. Put the magic office back to its original state. People have turned into monsters!!

lines.speaker: 레이븐
lines.text: People? What's wrong with people?

lines.speaker: 레티시아
lines.text: Wizard, what are you talking about? Don’t you know what a person is?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Letty, I will do it.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Raven. If things continue like this, not only the wizards within the Magic Agency but also the residents of Glaston are in danger. So stop what you're doing.

lines.speaker: 레이븐
lines.text: Stop?

lines.speaker: 레이븐
lines.text: Why should I do that?

lines.speaker: 레이븐
lines.text: You ruined something I took so long to build, so why should I stop?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: No way… … .

lines.speaker: 레이븐
lines.text: Even when Zelenis told me to stop, I didn't stop... ! Because I have a mission.

lines.speaker: 레이븐
lines.text: For this world, for a world without God... . For life in the world... .

lines.speaker: 레이븐
lines.text: I did research after research, but you ruined it. It's okay though. I have the power to do it again. You can start again.

lines.speaker: 레이븐
lines.text: Find a place to provide nutrients, make a container... .

lines.speaker: 레티시아
lines.text: This is why I hear wizards have no social skills. I stay in a dark place, read strange books, and say strange things.

lines.speaker: 레티시아
lines.text: Please speak clearly!!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Letty… . That wizard is a criminal who committed a serious crime and is being chased by Argent.

lines.speaker: 레티시아
lines.text: Is that so? He's a bad guy. I need to catch him right away and scold him.
(Raven stops looking for the banned book, looks at the two people and frowns.)

lines.speaker: 레이븐
lines.text: Oh my, Nottoria.
Ohhh... .
(The monster looks at Raven.)

lines.speaker: 레이븐
lines.text: The primal power awakened from the banned book. The blood and tears gained from killing many angels and demons. I will soon create a key that will free you.

lines.speaker: 레이븐
lines.text: While you're looking for Goetia, Teurgia, Paulina, Almadel, and Nova, kill what's in front of you!!
(Nottoria, which had stopped for a moment with Raven's words, comes to mind on the spot.)
(Then it lunges at the two people, making a horrifying noise that seems out of this world.)
(Raven is surprised to see Ego Notoria dispersing like smoke from %s's blow. She is so surprised that she drops the book she was holding.)

lines.speaker: 레이븐
lines.text: Oh, I can’t believe Nottoria disappeared like this… Wow, I can't believe it... .

lines.speaker: 레이븐
lines.text: It doesn't make sense for a thought form that embodies part of the world's truth to disappear at the hands of a single Adventurer... .

lines.speaker: 레이븐
lines.text: … Because you have God’s protection? no. Even so, how did I break the seal... . That… .

lines.speaker: 레이븐
lines.text: This only becomes perfect when it comes back to the book!!
(As Ego Nottoria disappeared, the banned book that accompanied it was also stained with shadows and soon disappeared into ashes.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Raven, it's over now. Admit your mistake and receive the punishment.

lines.speaker: 레티시아
lines.text: %s, you're awesome. I feel like a hero who defeated a villain!
(Raven picks up the book she dropped as if nothing had happened.)

lines.speaker: 레이븐
lines.text: Wrong? crime? What did I do wrong?

lines.speaker: 레이븐
lines.text: I just did it like those with transcendental power. It's just that I guided foolish people to the right path... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Don't talk nonsense. What right do humans have over humans? .

lines.speaker: 레이븐
lines.text: I don't really want to make you understand.

lines.speaker: 레이븐
lines.text: I have waited hundreds of years for this moment... You can't give up your plan just because Nottoria is gone... .
(Raven opens the book she was holding and places her hand on it.)

lines.speaker: 레티시아
lines.text: If you do something stupid, you will be scolded!!
(The moment Leticia tries to kick at Raven at high speed, the magic building creates a tremendous vibration.)

lines.speaker: 레티시아
lines.text: Ugh.
(Adventurer leaves the fallen Leticia behind and runs to attack Raven. However, under the influence of the spell, the distorted space increases and the distance from Raven increases.)

lines.speaker: 레이븐
lines.text: Paulina, who binds everything in eternal time... . In this space... .
(The book that was in Raven's arms before he finished reciting the spell comes to mind.)

lines.speaker: 레티시아
lines.text: %s, take that!!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Uh, telekinesis?)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Okay, Letty!!
(Adventurer jumps high and catches the approaching book. Then, the shaking movement of the magic building stops.)
(The Magic Office, which was dominated by the power of the banned book, is seen gradually returning to its original form, albeit only in part.)
(And the distance from Raven, which had grown distant, narrows again.)

lines.speaker: 레이븐
lines.text: Damn, damn!! Why here… . I have to protect the remaining books... . Well, we have to break the seal... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Letty, catch that guy!

lines.speaker: 레티시아
lines.text: Yep!
(In response, Leticia tackles the legs of Raven, who appears to have nowhere else to run. Then, she ties the wrists of the fallen Raven with a chain prepared in advance.)

lines.speaker: 레이븐
lines.text: Ugh!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Raven, what is it about this book that makes you like this?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: tell me
(Raven closes her eyes and purses her lips tightly. Even though she is being held, she is still not letting go of the three books.)

lines.speaker: 레티시아
lines.text: %s, it's probably going to be hard to get an answer.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: … I'll have to hand it over to the knights.

lines.speaker: 레티시아
lines.text: Shall we go out now? Don't worry, I've tied up this criminal.

lines.speaker: 레티시아
lines.text: I think I can rest now that I have fulfilled my duty as a knight. lol.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (What did Raven see in this book that made her do such a thing….)
(The moment Adventurer thinks like that and looks at the book, everything in front of him freezes.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What, what?
(At the moment when darkness flowing from somewhere fills everything, a voice I have never heard before reaches %s's ears.)
「… Is it you?”
“In that case, I will allow you to view part of Ars Polina. “It is a record of time that will be helpful to you.”
“However, this time will be short because it is not yours to begin with.”

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Gasp.)
(As soon as I come to my senses, I try to scream, but no sound is heard.)
(A space where all of Etoire's time seems to have disappeared. Several sheets of paper are shining and circling around Adventurer as if swaying in the wind.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Can I move now?)
(There is nothing you can do except reach for the paper.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (...I think the being who created this space has blocked me from doing anything else..., what should I do?)
(While Adventurer is thinking, the papers that were emitting light fall to the floor. The papers buried in the dark are no longer visible.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (...is this why I said there was no time? There are only a few chapters left. Let’s hurry.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Which of the three should you choose?)
(Adventurer places his hand on a page where blue light hovers. Then, the light hovering on the page rises into the air, creating an afterimage of someone.)

lines.speaker: 아론
lines.text: The number of wizards has increased while I haven't seen it.

lines.speaker: 레이븐
lines.text: The faith of intelligent people is simple yet deep. I believe that the desire for new truth and knowledge can change the world.

lines.speaker: 레이븐
lines.text: So do I, and so do these people. Things are going smoothly. Thanks to you too.

lines.speaker: 레이븐
lines.text: Aaron, the power of the witch. How much have you saved?

lines.speaker: 아론
lines.text: No need to know.
(Raven chuckles at Aaron’s answer.)

lines.speaker: 레이븐
lines.text: At first, I was intrigued by your recognition of me as a person and your suggestion. Even though we've done a lot together, there's a lot we've been hiding.

lines.speaker: 레이븐
lines.text: When you recognized me, I recognized you too. It was really interesting that no one knew that the person leading the Tyenes family was always the same... .

lines.speaker: 레이븐
lines.text: Thanks to this, I was able to kill the disruptor Zerenis and gather a lot of beasts to create demons. I appreciate this.

lines.speaker: 레이븐
lines.text: Do you think that I, who glimpsed the truth of the world, would not know what demons like you are doing? You're waiting for a witch to be born into the royal family.

lines.speaker: 레이븐
lines.text: It will end on that day. You can achieve something you want... .

lines.speaker: 아론
lines.text: I won't deny it.

lines.speaker: 레이븐
lines.text: What deal did you make with the Rabbit Ear Witch? You kept asking me to make dishes for you.

lines.speaker: 아론
lines.text: That woman's child does not die. If that happens, your transaction with me will never end.

lines.speaker: 레이븐
lines.text: The rabbit witch must be holding the power of the witch she killed so far.
(The afterimage that seemed blurry in the dark gradually disappears and is no longer visible.)
(Adventurer places his hand on the page where yellow light hovers. Then, the light hovering on the page rises into the air, creating an afterimage of someone.)

lines.speaker: 레이븐
lines.text: The experiment using fear is progressing smoothly, but I don't know when it will be completed... .

lines.speaker: 아론
lines.text: You will need it when the time comes. Wait until then.

lines.speaker: 레이븐
lines.text: It would be nice if you excluded me from the demon world's plan at that time... .

lines.speaker: 아론
lines.text: I'll think about it, Crowley. however… , Is that child the vessel created this time?

lines.speaker: 레이븐
lines.text: The bowl made this time is pretty good. For a long time it mixed many souls and made them dream within the channels of Rashuet.

lines.speaker: 레이븐
lines.text: When he woke up, he woke up the sleeping ancient magic golem. It's a pretty nice bowl. If you have any regrets, is that your emotions haven't stabilized yet?

lines.speaker: 레이븐
lines.text: So I used a nobleman. You know? Gentleman, who is widely rumored these days... .

lines.speaker: 레이븐
lines.text: He got into some trouble when he threw the dead into the ditch. At that time, the vessel escaped and hid in the warehouse of the magic office.

lines.speaker: 레이븐
lines.text: He barely caught him, but he killed the person who tried to save him. Since wizards have been causing pain for a long time, I thought he would do the same.

lines.speaker: 레이븐
lines.text: It's a shame that a wizard like Nemo died, but it would have been a new experience for Noname. It will be better than Atalanta, which is being scrapped.

lines.speaker: 레이븐
lines.text: Lux by the way. Was killing the emperor part of your plan? What is it about the appearance of a demon called Barbatos?

lines.speaker: 레이븐
lines.text: I also know that Princess Shiina is the reincarnation of the woman who was the first emperor of the empire. However, other than having superior magical power... .

lines.speaker: 아론
lines.text: You are a person with many questions. Then I will answer you.

lines.speaker: 아론
lines.text: I don't know which of the three sisters is destined to become a witch... … .
(Adventurer places his hand on a page where a red light hovers. Then, the light hovering on the page rises into the air, creating an afterimage of someone.)
“Crawley!!”

lines.speaker: 크롤리
lines.text: Teacher, no matter what you say, I will move toward my will.
“Humans should only do what they can do as humans. “What you are trying to do now is denying humanity!!”

lines.speaker: 크롤리
lines.text: Teacher always said that magic exists for humans. So he used magic for the people.

lines.speaker: 크롤리
lines.text: I also followed the teacher's wishes, but I felt that it was not enough.

lines.speaker: 크롤리
lines.text: The reason you are called an archmage is because you can use magic that ordinary people cannot use. It's a blessing.

lines.speaker: 크롤리
lines.text: This is a world where it is natural to use the blessings that only a few can enjoy for those who cannot use magic.

lines.speaker: 크롤리
lines.text: So I try to go the extra mile for them.

lines.speaker: 크롤리
lines.text: The ancient truth that was left untouched for the sake of Freios, whom the gods abandoned... .
“There is a reason why it was set as a taboo and sealed in a forbidden book!!”

lines.speaker: 크롤리
lines.text: Is that so?

lines.speaker: 크롤리
lines.text: Even so, breaking the taboo is enough. It would be enough to look at banned books.

lines.speaker: 크롤리
lines.text: Teacher.

lines.speaker: 크롤리
lines.text: Your magic is so outdated that I can't stand it. Now I will take over your will... .
“Yes, this guy, Crowley… … … … .」

lines.speaker: 크롤리
lines.text: Rest in peace.

lines.speaker: 크롤리
lines.text: Zerenis, the narrow-minded and foolish wizard I once respected... .
(The pages that were shining fall to the floor and disappear into the darkness.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Crawley… … .

steps.name: suspicious gate
steps.objective: Talk to [Leticia] in the Glaston Administrative District, and report the quest to [Jinigarden Bluebird] in the Glaston Administrative District.

lines.text: (Adventurer is startled by the tremendous light that stings her eyes and looks around. Then she makes eye contact with Leticia, who is looking at her with concern.)

lines.speaker: 레티시아
lines.text: %s, are you okay? Cluck, cluck.
(Leticia wipes the blood from her lips and looks sorry.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'm fine, but what's wrong with Leti?

lines.speaker: 레티시아
lines.text: I should have held on to that wizard better... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes? What is that... .

lines.speaker: 레티시아
lines.text: Don't you remember? I was grabbing Raven and trying to get out, but %s muttered that it was Crowley!

lines.speaker: 레티시아
lines.text: Suddenly, Raven gets surprised and the magic book explodes.

lines.speaker: 레티시아
lines.text: So it flew out of the cage! Don't you remember?

lines.speaker: 레티시아
lines.text: You really don't remember. Anyway, Raven took advantage of that opportunity and ran away, and the Spirit King chased after her!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Is Letty okay?

lines.speaker: 레티시아
lines.text: The Spirit King gave me a mysterious mushroom, and when I ate it, I got better. %s, would you like some too?
(At that time, the Peekaboo floating in the sky cries at the two people as if it had seen something.)

lines.speaker: 피카부
lines.text: Pour! Pour!

lines.speaker: 레티시아
lines.text: I think Peekaboo saw something over there. Peekaboo, is the Spirit King over there?

lines.speaker: 피카부
lines.text: Pour!

lines.speaker: 레티시아
lines.text: %s, go over there like Peekaboo said. Is this really okay?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It's okay, Letty. It's no problem. Uh, I see something over there... .

lines.speaker: 레티시아
lines.text: Are you talking about the gate?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Gate?

lines.speaker: 레티시아
lines.text: Do you know the gate that moves with magic? It's also at the Nereis Gate.

lines.speaker: 레티시아
lines.text: It is said that wizards from the Ministry of Magic built it at some point, but it is currently unused and left unused.

lines.speaker: 레티시아
lines.text: Even if I run away there, I won’t be able to do anything… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (No way….)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Let's go quickly.

lines.speaker: 레티시아
lines.text: Uh, isn't Peekaboo going?

lines.speaker: 피카부
lines.text: Pour!

lines.speaker: 레티시아
lines.text: Okay, then, avoid the monsters and go to the square with your friends, okay?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Thanks, Peekaboo. See you later.

lines.speaker: 피카부
lines.text: Ow!

steps.objective:
