lines.text: (As we run into the administrative district following Leticia, there is a large gate erected that is not in use, as explained earlier.)
(Sylphid sits on the gate and looks blankly at the sky.)

lines.speaker: 실피드
lines.text: Sting. How do I do this?

lines.speaker: 레티시아
lines.text: Spirit King, what’s the problem?

lines.speaker: 실피드
lines.text: Sting. Are you two okay?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: For now, I think it's okay. Silphid, I have something to tell you... .Do you know this?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Tell Silphid a story related to Ars Paulina.)

lines.speaker: 실피드
lines.text: Sting. You... . Sting. Even as a spirit king, I feel like I've been to an area I don't know about. What should I say?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes?

lines.speaker: 실피드
lines.text: Sting. First of all, Raven. No, Crowley.

lines.speaker: 실피드
lines.text: Sting. The contents of the banned book, the primordial power that was said to be the truth of the world. To use it, you have to risk everything.

lines.speaker: 실피드
lines.text: Sting. Otherwise, humans or anything else won't give up their power. You must have power, but... . Anyway, it seems like Crowley risked himself to touch the banned book and break the seal.

lines.speaker: 실피드
lines.text: Sting. One of them materialized and fell into your hands. Moreover, if another force recognized you and showed you Crowley's past... .

lines.speaker: 실피드
lines.text: Sting. Crowley will no longer be able to use things he saw in banned books. but… .

lines.speaker: 레티시아
lines.text: Are you trying to tell me that that socially inept man went to a place where he could use that power?

lines.speaker: 실피드
lines.text: Sting. that's right. You speak well. Kid.

lines.speaker: 레티시아
lines.text: Thank you, Spirit King.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: If this gate does its job, and if Crowley can go anywhere... , Perhaps the Demon World… .

lines.speaker: 실피드
lines.text: Sting. You are right. Beyond this gate is the Demon World. I can feel it faintly, so it's quite far away, but it must be connected.

lines.speaker: 실피드
lines.text: Sting.  I heard that the road to the Demon World is longer than I thought... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: If you use the power of banned books in the demon world, something even more terrible will happen than now. Then we'll have to open the door here... .

lines.speaker: 실피드
lines.text: Sting. Only demons can open the door to the demon world.

lines.speaker: 실피드
lines.text: Sting. The Demon World is another world that exists beyond the great wall and denies everything. To go from our world to the demon world, you need god-level power.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Iris… .

lines.speaker: 실피드
lines.text: Sting. that's right. Iris, who is building the great wall, needs to help.

lines.speaker: 레티시아
lines.text: Spirit King, where is he now? Just tell me where you are and I will come quickly.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Letty, it's okay. I can talk about it.

lines.speaker: 레티시아
lines.text: Yes? How?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Iris… , are you okay?
(With the words of %s, a sphere of light appears and sparkles in front of the group from somewhere.)

lines.speaker: 실피드
lines.text: Sting. Iris, are you here?

lines.speaker: 이리스의 목소리
lines.text: Hello Silphid. Hello Leticia too.

lines.speaker: 레티시아
lines.text: Uh, where is that voice coming from? Is this the one that sparkles?

lines.speaker: 실피드
lines.text: Sting. Kid. Stay calm. She is a goddess.

lines.speaker: 레티시아
lines.text: Wow, you’re the goddess I’ve only heard about?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Iris, To chase Crowley... I need help from Iris.

lines.speaker: 이리스의 목소리
lines.text: It's okay. Chasing Crowley comes first. Let me reorganize part of this area briefly. Then it will be possible, even if it is only for a moment.

lines.speaker: 이리스의 목소리
lines.text: I don't have time. Everyone please step back.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Okay, Iris. Letty, come behind me.

lines.speaker: 레티시아
lines.text: Yes.

(The sphere of light floating in the sky moves in front of the empty gate and grows bigger. Then, in the middle of it, the figure of someone who seems to have all the clear and beautiful light in the world is revealed.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: … Iris?
(Iris, a new figure never seen before, is looking at the gate with a large bow in one hand.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (That is Celestia….)

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: My world.

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: My name is Iris. A descendant of the Der tribe left behind by Ceres.

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: My world. Our world, where we sacredly remember the names of all living beings who open and close their eyes.
(As soon as Iris finished speaking, a beam of light flew from the sky and circled Celestia. The circling light soon flowed into Iris's fingertips and became a beautiful arrow of light.)

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: We will pierce the unholy darkness, so let me and Der's bow be the light at the end of Celestia.
(The increasingly sharp arrow of light leaves Celestia and heads forward.)
Hehehe.
(With the sound of a sharp wind, the arrow lands in the center of the empty gate.)
(Then the invisible wall splits, and some parts fall to the floor like fragments and disappear like dust.)

lines.speaker: 실피드
lines.text: Sting. That place… .
(Just by looking beyond the closed gate, you can see a road that feels very ominous. And the castle at the end of the road is shining under the purple moon.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (I got the same feeling when I entered Rosengarten...)

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: The castle at the end of the road is the realm of the demon world. Sorry, %s.

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: I want to chase Raven together, but if I take even one step into the demon world... . Beings from other worlds will come to target this world.

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: It is said that even the few remaining gods abandoned Etoire... . Now, hurry up.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yeah.

lines.speaker: 실피드
lines.text: Sting. Iris is correct, %s. Leave this to me.

lines.speaker: 레티시아
lines.text: I'm going to catch the bad guy too!

lines.speaker: 실피드
lines.text: Sting. Kid. It's a dangerous place for even a spirit to go, but it's even more dangerous for an ordinary human.

lines.speaker: 실피드
lines.text: Sting. You must keep me and other monsters from coming.

lines.speaker: 레티시아
lines.text: I can't help it. I understand.

lines.speaker: 레티시아
lines.text: Uh, %s. There's a Raven running over there!!
(Leticia spots Raven inside the gate and points in that direction.)
(Raven, who was not seen until a moment ago, is looking around anxiously, holding the magic book in her arms.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Iris, I'll be back.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I will definitely catch Raven, or rather Crowley, and make them pay for their crimes.
(Adventurer leaves behind everyone who sees him off and runs inside the gate towards the passage that becomes the border of the demon world.)
(A large road built on blue clouds spreads out endlessly, bathed in purple light. And on the road, it is stained with an ominous red liquid.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: … What is this?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Sometimes it looks like blood, sometimes it doesn’t… . Uh, that… .
(A magic circle is drawn on the floor of a large circular section large enough to fill dozens or hundreds of people. Blue flames can be seen surrounding it.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What on earth is here... .
(%s, who was looking around, sees Raven wandering down the street again.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I think I can catch up with that.
(At that moment, Raven and %s’s eyes meet.)
(Unlike how anxious he looked a moment ago, Raven shows a deep sneer at %s. Then, he runs towards the castle at high speed.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I don't know what they're planning on the other end... , it won’t work out the way you want… . Crowley.
(%s's steps stop in a space so large that you don't know how far he ran or how deep he went.)
(Raven is stopping in front of a dead end road where he can no longer proceed, looking at Adventurer.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I can't run away anymore. There's nowhere else to go, Raven.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: No, Crowley.
(Raven grins as the name Crowley comes out of %s's mouth.)

lines.speaker: 레이븐
lines.text: When was the last time you heard that name from someone else's mouth? I lived under the name Raven for a long time.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What do you want to say?

lines.speaker: 레이븐
lines.text: If you saw my past in Ars Polina, you would know what kind of person I am, right?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Actually, I didn't want to know... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: If you want to hear it, there's nothing you can do... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: He murdered the wizard Zerenis and tried to create a demon using the power of the forbidden book... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: In the process of creating demons, they incited wizards and used Creed residents... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: … Many people died. What do you say, what do you say? Why did you do that?
(A smile appears on Raven's face as she looks at Adventurer in silence.)

lines.speaker: 레이븐
lines.text: A special human being who receives God's protection knows nothing. It's the same as stupid Zerenis who didn't use her power even though she had it.

lines.speaker: 레이븐
lines.text: The gods who were fighting each other were either eaten by the Beast or ran away. The devil took the gods' vacant place, so what did the gods do for such a long time?

lines.speaker: 레이븐
lines.text: I felt so sorry for this world. So I tried to create a new world.

lines.speaker: 레이븐
lines.text: But Zerenis came to see the truth of the world? There was power in it, so I could have brought it with me... .

lines.speaker: 레이븐
lines.text: I sealed it and didn't do anything. Foolish human being. Even though I asked him to write like that, he kept ignoring me… .

lines.speaker: 레이븐
lines.text: Great things require sacrifice.

lines.speaker: 레이븐
lines.text: So I killed him, used his power to break the seal, and caught a glimpse of the truth. It's not my fault that Zerenis died. He brought it upon himself.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Are you saying that?

lines.speaker: 레이븐
lines.text: When I heard the message to create a god who would become the master of the new world, I made that my mission.

lines.speaker: 레이븐
lines.text: For a long time, I worked hard to establish a research center linked to the Magic Agency.

lines.speaker: 레이븐
lines.text: For the poor world where the gods have disappeared... .

lines.speaker: 레이븐
lines.text: For the sake of life in this pitiful world... .

lines.speaker: 레이븐
lines.text: It's something I risk doing on behalf of everyone.

lines.speaker: 레이븐
lines.text: The only ones who understood me were the demons. Hehehe.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: You are crazy… .

lines.speaker: 레이븐
lines.text: I don't care if you say I'm crazy. Because this is my mission, and I just follow my mission.

lines.speaker: 레이븐
lines.text: I will continue my mission here. %s.

lines.speaker: 레이븐
lines.text: Now that I think about it, I don't think I'll need to make new dishes again for a long time. There's some great ingredients here.

lines.speaker: 레이븐
lines.text: You won't become the material yourself. So I will show you the power of truth. Even if it isn't perfect, it will have the power to make you into material.

lines.speaker: 레이븐
lines.text: I’m not trustworthy about doing it at the location provided by Lux, but… .
(Raven throws her glasses on the floor, opens all the banned books she was holding, and mutters like crazy.)

lines.speaker: 레이븐
lines.text: Goetia, the evil energy buried by the ancient gods in the darkness of the beginning.

lines.speaker: 레이븐
lines.text: Theurgia, the primordial life force from which the ancient gods created the spirits.

lines.speaker: 레이븐
lines.text: Almadel, the power of obedience through which the Old Gods move the angels.

lines.speaker: 레이븐
lines.text: Nova, the star of the abyss that spits out all wounds and tears.

lines.speaker: 레이븐
lines.text: … I will create a god again for this poor world, so give me your strength!!
(A shadow flows out of the opened banned book at high speed, accompanied by a strange sound. The shadow soon grows so large that Adventurer cannot approach it, enveloping the book and Raven.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ugh, ugh. You can't get closer... .
(Adventurer continues to be pushed back due to the vortex created with the black shadow.)

lines.speaker: 레이븐
lines.text: Hahahaha. Yes, this is it! This is true power. Hahahaha.

lines.speaker: 레이븐
lines.text: Kwaaaaak, kwaaaa!!
(Raven suddenly screams in pain.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: … What, what?!
(Raven is struggling against something that is attacking her, but it is not visible.)
(After a while, as the whirlpool faded, what was glimpsed was a forbidden book baring its fangs like a demonic beast.)

lines.speaker: 레이븐
lines.text: Big, big!! Stop it!! Why, why me... . Argh!!

lines.speaker: 레이븐
lines.text: Wow!!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh, that doesn't make sense... .
(The four banned books swallow Raven's hands and feet, one after another. Then, the shadows from the books gather and gradually transform into books.)

lines.speaker: 레이븐
lines.text: All you have to do is give me strength, why are you like this!! Wow!!
(With Raven's words, the new book that was staring at Raven opens its mouth wide and swallows his head.)
(After a while, fresh blood rises from the shadows.)

lines.speaker: 레이븐
lines.text: Ugh… . Ahhh… . Save me... .
(Raven's voice, which was struggling to hold on, gradually becomes quieter. Then, Raven's arms and legs go limp and fall to the floor.)
(After a while, the shadows and whirlpool that appeared in front of Raven disappear, leaving only a miserable image.)
(Something like devil's horns sprout from the book that swallowed Crowley's head. Then, the red liquid that had been spotted on the floor rises and rushes at him.)
(Humans swallowed by blood and darkness suddenly take the form of grotesque monsters that distance themselves from humans.)

lines.speaker: 레이븐
lines.text: Wow!
(The monster that was both Raven and Crowley comes to his senses and looks around. Then, the place where Adventurer was standing shakes tremendously.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ugh… .

lines.speaker: 레이븐
lines.text: I feel more powerful than when I only used magic. Is this the power of banned books?

lines.speaker: 레이븐
lines.text: This is the power that can change the world... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Don't talk nonsense, Crowley!

lines.speaker: 레이븐
lines.text: I am no longer Raven or Crowley!! The agent who kills you and establishes a god... .
(The monster that gave its head to the forbidden book stares at Adventurer.)

lines.speaker: 라우드스키나
lines.text: Loudskina… .

lines.speaker: 라우드스키나
lines.text: And this is the best place to spread the world’s truth. Pseudaria… .
Weeeeing.
(A large ring containing magical power is created as if surrounding the monster that identifies itself as Loudskina.)

lines.speaker: 라우드스키나
lines.text: As long as I have this power, you will not be able to go back.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: To say something like that over something that isn't even yours... .

lines.speaker: 라우드스키나
lines.text: I won't even let you say that anymore. Die, Adventurer of God!!

lines.speaker: 라우드스키나
lines.text: Wow... .
(%s's attack passes by Loudskina.)
(The book that swallowed Crowley's head coughs and spits out red liquid.)

lines.speaker: 라우드스키나
lines.text: Cluck, cluck.
(Raudskina, who was struggling to hold on, attacks %s again, but is rendered useless by the strong counterattack.)

lines.speaker: 라우드스키나
lines.text: Hehehe, hehehe… .

lines.speaker: 라우드스키나
lines.text: It can't be like this. This is why I can't start research again. again… .
(The Loudskina tries to attack again, but this time it doesn't even reach %s.)

lines.speaker: 라우드스키나
lines.text: Me, me, I'm Crowley. He is said to be a great man who became the head of the Magic Agency due to his powerful magic skills, and even created a demon god through long research.

lines.speaker: 라우드스키나
lines.text: It doesn't make sense that I can't defeat a person like you... .

lines.speaker: 라우드스키나
lines.text: I have to fulfill my mission. So... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: If you achieve your mission, what happens next?

lines.speaker: 라우드스키나
lines.text: That’s… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What do you think the demon created in your hands will do to you? Will life be happy in a world dominated by fakes? There is no room for current life in that world.

lines.speaker: 라우드스키나
lines.text: I, who have glimpsed the truth, will be wherever I am!! So, just become the ingredients for the bowl... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Even after getting to this point, you still don't realize it.
(The ring surrounding Loudskina breaks, and the body of the person who was Crowley turns into liquid and flows out little by little.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: The world you took lightly is not at all pitiful. Even if I fell, I got up and continued to hold on.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It's not the world that's pitiful... .
(The moment %s's attack is directed at Loudskina again, a large object falls to the ground.)
Boom.
(The book opened its mouth and let go of Crowley's head. Crowley, who had been held a moment ago, fell and rolled around on the floor.)
Ugh.
(The moment Adventurer raises its head to find a strange sound, Geumseo rushes in, baring its sharp teeth.)
(And that only lasts a moment. The forbidden book, unable to swallow anything, is torn apart in %s's hands and falls on Crowley's head.)
“No!! The truth is there, but you make it like this... . Lord, you can't get close to death... .」
(Crawley reaches out and struggles, but does nothing. He only receives a disdainful look from Adventurer.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Crowley.
“A special being who can use magic… . So for this poor world... .」
(Before Crowley finished speaking, %s's hand holding the weapon tightened.)
“I didn’t believe in a demon like Lux… . Wow!!”

(A person who has been deluded for a long time without a sense of guilt disappears as if evaporating on the spot. And the suspicious moonlight that was hanging on the border of the demon world illuminates the place.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (I feel dirtier than ever...)
(Then I see something that looks like a path leading to another place, but an unknown wall blocks it, as if Adventurer is not allowed.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: The goal is not to go there now. For now, I have no choice but to go back... .
(The road back outside is full of ominousness as traces of the demon world still remain.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (So what should I do now? Lux….)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (I need to kill Lux, but can I do it properly? I don't even know how much power she has yet...)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (And Daphne….)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Do not overthink it. Let us go back and talk to Iris first.
(Adventurer turns around and runs back the way it came.)
… This is really great. %s.
(As Adventurer disappears so far away that it is no longer reflected in the moonlight, someone slowly walks out from the blocked road in the direction of the Demon World.)

lines.speaker: 다프네
lines.text: At first, I was worried about whether he would survive, but now I am all rooting for him.
(Daphne quietly moves her gaze downward and looks at the torn traces of the banned book.)

lines.speaker: 다프네
lines.text: You foolishly believed in demons. Not knowing that Lux had lent his hand to see the completion of the Lemegeton... .
(Daphne looks at the ominous moon in the sky and smiles.)

lines.speaker: 다프네
lines.text: There is a reason why things that were considered truth were buried by the hand of God.

lines.speaker: 다프네
lines.text: Aaron… .

lines.speaker: 다프네
lines.text: I think they are watching and listening from somewhere here. If so, let me tell you.

lines.speaker: 다프네
lines.text: Your plan is already ruined. Many people know your identity and purpose.

lines.speaker: 다프네
lines.text: So I think now is the right time.

lines.speaker: 다프네
lines.text: It's time to make you pay for testing me.

steps.name: A person who reveals his true colors
steps.objective: Talk to [Passing Bluebird] in the “Glaston Administrative District” and report the quest to [Leticia] in the “Street North of the Square”.

lines.text: (The moment Adventurer steps towards the door that is thought to be the outer border, everything in the world becomes dizzy, mixed with various lights.)
Sting.
(I feel something sitting on my head, so I raise my head and see the fluttering feathers of a small blue bird.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh, Sylphid?

lines.speaker: 실피드
lines.text: Sting. Are you okay?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It’s okay… . But what about Iris?

lines.speaker: 실피드
lines.text: Sting. Iris passed away because he could no longer stay away.

lines.speaker: 레티시아
lines.text: %s, are you okay? What did you do with that bad guy?

lines.speaker: 실피드
lines.text: Sting. Yes, %s. What happened to that wizard?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: That… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (I explained to Silphid what happened inside the gate.)

lines.speaker: 레티시아
lines.text: Wow, he really is a bad guy!! Even in such a situation, shamelessly until the end... .

lines.speaker: 실피드
lines.text: Sting. Thank you for your hard work.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: No… .

lines.speaker: 실피드
lines.text: Sting. I know how you feel.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It'll be okay after a while. But, are there no more monsters?

lines.speaker: 레티시아
lines.text: That makes sense, it disappears at some point.

lines.speaker: 실피드
lines.text: Sting. The spirit that was drunk with the poison has returned to its original place, and the Magic Agency's owl wizards are coming out and vomiting.

lines.speaker: 실피드
lines.text: Sting. The demons of the demon world quickly ran away somewhere.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I see. Oh, what about the wizards who turned into monsters while in the magic office?

lines.speaker: 실피드
lines.text: Sting. The moment the power of the banned book disappeared, their hearts naturally stopped.

lines.speaker: 실피드
lines.text: Sting. Listening to Peekaboo, it seemed like the wizards were in a hurry to retrieve research-related materials and samples.

lines.speaker: 실피드
lines.text: Sting. Raven must have traded the lives of the wizards who helped her when she used the forbidden book.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: … Quickly catch Aaron... .

lines.speaker: 실피드
lines.text: Sting. %s. Now is not the time to move. Just because there is food in front of you, you shouldn’t rush at it. Because there might be a trap.

lines.speaker: 실피드
lines.text: Sting. And kid.

lines.speaker: 레티시아
lines.text: Yes, Spirit King.

lines.speaker: 실피드
lines.text: Sting. Everything you see and hear here is secret. Okay?

lines.speaker: 레티시아
lines.text: Why?

lines.speaker: 실피드
lines.text: Sting. If I told you that an ordinary human saw a spirit king who spoke like a bird and a goddess, you wouldn't believe me, right?

lines.speaker: 실피드
lines.text: Sting. Can you think of it as being on a secret mission or something?

lines.speaker: 레티시아
lines.text: Wow, something like a hero. Okay.

lines.speaker: 실피드
lines.text: Sting. The soldiers are running. What's going on? There are no more monsters or demons... .

lines.speaker: 레티시아
lines.text: If they are soldiers, are they soldiers from the Congress? Since I'm a hero-like knight, I'll tell you what's going on.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (The atmosphere among the soldiers is a little strange... Just like in the past...)

lines.speaker: 레티시아
lines.text: Hey… … .
(Before Leticia has time to say anything, guerrillas surround the group and raise guerrilla rifles to threaten them.)

lines.speaker: 레티시아
lines.text: What are you doing now?!

lines.speaker: 유격병
lines.text: … At the Gates of Destruction... The anger that flows down will burn everything... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Silphid!!
(The moment the guerrilla pulls the trigger of the rifle, a large whirlpool occurs.)

lines.speaker: 실피드
lines.text: Sting. These. I was brainwashed by the energy of the demon world. Kid, quickly take away the weapon.

lines.speaker: 레티시아
lines.text: Yes, Spirit King!!
(Leticia tries to throw the soldiers' rifles away with her telekinesis, but then drops them. Meanwhile, Adventurer overpowers the surprised guerrilla and knocks him down.)
(But that only lasts for a moment. Brainwashed guerrillas appear from somewhere and surround them again.)

lines.speaker: 레티시아
lines.text: Ha, ha... . There are too many soldiers... . Plus, he's ridiculously strong... .

lines.speaker: 실피드
lines.text: Sting. Since they are ordinary humans, all we have to do is knock them out, so it takes a long time. %s, soldiers… . for a moment.

lines.speaker: 실피드
lines.text: Sting. Someone is coming.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes… .
(The movement of the guerrillas surrounding the party stops. And, as if the sea is splitting, two people walk towards the %s party.)

lines.speaker: 아론
lines.text: Now, tell me in detail what you saw.

lines.speaker: 페타
lines.text: I saw it clearly with my own two eyes. That person dragged the Magician Raven into there.
(Peta, a magician from the Ministry of Magic, points to a gate that is not currently working.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Feta?

lines.speaker: 아론
lines.text: Suspected of conniving with demons and kidnapping Raven, a magician belonging to the Magic Agency. This should be enough.

lines.speaker: 아론
lines.text: Now, redeem this man.
(The soldiers approach %s as promised in Aaron's words. However, they step back in surprise when they see the card in %s's hand.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Are you reacting to this card?)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I was carrying out a mission related to Raven under the name of Hwang.

lines.speaker: 유격병 A
lines.text: Excuse me. Uh, Chairman Aaron, what’s going on here… ?

lines.speaker: 유격병 B
lines.text: Weren't we at the Capitol a little while ago?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Has the brainwashing been lifted...?)
(Aaron chuckles as if he realized something. After a while, darkness comes from somewhere and covers the administrative district.)
(All living things in the area where the darkness passed stop moving and collapse. Even the spirit king, Sylphid, who was sitting on a tree observing the situation, falls to the ground.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (How on earth are you controlling space and time? Now, wait a minute?)
(Before I could understand the situation, the darkness that had covered the air flew towards Aaron.)

lines.speaker: 아론
lines.text: You're trying to disturb me... .

lines.speaker: 아론
lines.text: I accept the will of beings that are denied in the world. Daphne.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Daphne?

lines.speaker: 아론
lines.text: I'll put off dealing with you for a moment. Instead, you will have to stay alive until then... .
(With Aaron’s words, the darkness around him rises into the sky like a waterfall.)
(After a while, the ominous darkness that has grown to cover Glaston falls as if announcing the end of the world.)

steps.name: good luck
steps.objective: After talking to [Leticia] in the “Street North of the Square,” move toward “Glaston Central Square.” And when everything is done, press the quest completion button.

lines.speaker: 레티시아
lines.text: %s! %s, wake up!!
(With the sound of a voice coming from somewhere, the darkness that blocked the way disappears as if evaporating.)

lines.speaker: 실피드
lines.text: Sting, are you okay?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ah, Sylphid… . But here… The street north of the square?

lines.speaker: 레티시아
lines.text: That's right.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: There was definitely Lux in front of that door... … … .

lines.speaker: 실피드
lines.text: Sting. There is no one there now.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes?

lines.speaker: 레티시아
lines.text: I came all the way here with %s, who had fallen. Are you okay? It's okay, right?

lines.speaker: 실피드
lines.text: Sting. Kid. Before that, we need to talk about the content.

lines.speaker: 레티시아
lines.text: Oops.

lines.speaker: 실피드
lines.text: Sting. When I came to my senses, Lux, who had disguised herself as a human, was no longer there. The wizard and guerrilla Lux brought with them went back without even knowing why they came.

lines.speaker: 실피드
lines.text: Sting. And what happened in the magic office never happened. The magic flowing from the banned book did not erode the building. There was no banned book itself.

lines.speaker: 레티시아
lines.text: People can't remember anything. Just a little while ago, I was just running away from monsters... .

lines.speaker: 레티시아
lines.text: Why are we the only ones who remember?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Leti, I'm sorry I can't explain everything.

lines.speaker: 레티시아
lines.text: Can I think of it as similar to having telekinetic powers?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It’s similar… .

lines.speaker: 레티시아
lines.text: Yes, I knew what you meant. Well, the day will come when you'll find out later. It's a secret mission, so I'll protect it until the end.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Thank you, Letty.

lines.speaker: 실피드
lines.text: Sting. %s, the current situation is all due to that witch's abilities, right?

lines.speaker: 실피드
lines.text: Sting. Wasn't Lux plotting things with the witch?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'm not sure, but maybe... .

lines.speaker: 실피드
lines.text: Sting. Now I can hear the voices of the spirits in Glaston, so I'll do some research.
(Sylphid closes his eyes to focus on the chirping of birds coming from somewhere.)

lines.speaker: 실피드
lines.text: Sting, stab.

lines.speaker: 실피드
lines.text: Sting. uh. uh? uh… . uh? uh?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Silphid, why are you doing this?

lines.speaker: 실피드
lines.text: Sting. It seems like the soldiers and knights in the castle are looking for you. You tried to murder the emperor.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: There's no way I could do that. Wait a minute… .

lines.speaker: 실피드
lines.text: Sting. It seems like false memories of other events have been overwritten. It seems like all my memories related to the Magic Agency have evaporated... .
(As soon as Silphid finishes speaking, a small light flickers around %s. And from within, Iris's urgent voice flows out.)

lines.speaker: 이리스의 목소리
lines.text: Mr. Silphid. Get back to the canyon quickly. It seems like the gates of the Demon World are about to be reconnected.

lines.speaker: 실피드
lines.text: Sting. yes? Ah, yes! Let's go right away. %s, I'm sorry. See you later.
(Sylphid hears Iris and hurries into the sky.)

lines.speaker: 이리스의 목소리
lines.text: %s, you have to avoid it quickly. I'm trying to find a way here now, but I think it will take some time.

lines.speaker: 이리스의 목소리
lines.text: There is a safe place, Dorothy's Village, not far from Glaston... … .
(Iris's voice, which continued the story, can no longer be heard. Moreover, the light that conveyed the voice evaporates.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Iris? Iris?!

lines.speaker: 레티시아
lines.text: Goddess, where have you gone? Goddess? uh. %s. The leader is here.
(Argent hurriedly approaches %s with an urgent expression different from usual.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Argent?

lines.speaker: 아르젠트
lines.text: %s, I've been looking for it for a while. You must hurry.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes?

lines.speaker: 아르젠트
lines.text: I don't know what to say, but suddenly all the knights and soldiers except our knights are chasing %s.

lines.speaker: 아르젠트
lines.text: I know %s would never threaten His Majesty, but they really believe it.

lines.speaker: 아르젠트
lines.text: His Majesty has repeatedly explained that it was a misunderstanding and that such a thing did not happen, but his subjects, including the nobles in the Council, do not believe it.

lines.speaker: 아르젠트
lines.text: There was even a witness who said he saw it clearly, and a wanted order was issued by order of the council. You must evacuate quickly.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Did Aaron give instructions? Where is Aaron now?

lines.speaker: 아르젠트
lines.text: I couldn't confirm where he was now and whether he ordered this situation or not. First of all, take shelter and plan for later... .
(At that moment, the footsteps of knights and soldiers can be heard coming from the street north of the square.)
There is a sinner!
Go and catch the criminal!

lines.speaker: 아르젠트
lines.text: Your Majesty said you will be fine if you go to Oscar Road, so you should hurry.

lines.speaker: 아르젠트
lines.text: Letty.

lines.speaker: 레티시아
lines.text: Yes, Captain.

lines.speaker: 아르젠트
lines.text: While I'm holding them off, take %s to Oscar Drive. It's a mission.
(Argent puts on the helmet he was holding with those words. He then runs towards the knights and soldiers running towards him.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Argent, wait a minute!

lines.speaker: 레티시아
lines.text: %s, no! The leader told me to leave quickly. There was also His Majesty!

lines.speaker: 레티시아
lines.text: Don't you know that even if you enter a dragon's nest, you can eat your friend if you come to your senses? Quickly come to your senses and follow me!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: But, Argent… .

lines.speaker: 레티시아
lines.text: Let’s go quickly!! If you do this, you will be eaten by the dragon!!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I understand. Take the lead, Letty.

lines.speaker: 레티시아
lines.text: Yes, %s. Follow me!
(Adventurer leaves Argent fighting the soldiers behind and follows Leticia into a narrow alley.)
(Meanwhile, the rabbit-eared woman watching Adventurer from the highest point in the administrative district lets out a small sigh.)

lines.speaker: 다프네
lines.text: As the moon is waning, the Emperor is sending you to the Oscar Road. Even the emperor wouldn't have noticed that... .

lines.speaker: 다프네
lines.text: You'd have to be lucky to meet the witch of Dorothy's village... .

lines.speaker: 다프네
lines.text: I can't help it... .

lines.speaker: 다프네
lines.text: Hehe, all I can do is wish you luck.
